identity.title: RIOJA. JWST and ALMA Unveil the Inhomogeneous and Complex Interstellar Medium Structure in a Star-forming Galaxy at z = 6.81

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report the discovery of a complex, density-stratified interstellar medium (ISM) in the star-forming galaxy COS-2987 at _z_ = 6 _._ 81, revealed by the unprecedented synergy between JWST/NIRSpec IFS and ALMA observations.

Although Witstok et al. (2022) presented the initial detection and results of the [O iii]88 line, we reanalyzed the data cube to uniformly measure the line flux of COS-2987 in a manner consistent with other RIOJA studies.

evidence.quote: Here, we present a combined analysis of optical and FIR [O iii] emission lines in COS-2987030247 (hereafter COS-2987; Smit et al. 2015; Laporte et al. 2017; Smit et al. 2018; Witstok et al. 2022; Posses et al. 2023; Harikane et al. 2025a; Mawatari et al. 2025), a star-forming galaxy at _z_ = 6 _._ 81.

question.value: Investigate whether a density stratification of highly ionized gas in the z = 6.81 star-forming galaxy COS-2987 can be identified by combining rest-frame optical (JWST/NIRSpec IFS) and far-infrared (ALMA) [O III] emission lines.

evidence.quote: Motivated by these findings, we investigate whether a similar stratification of highly ionized gas can be identified by combining rest-frame optical and far-infrared (FIR) [O iii] emission lines

claims.experiment: Compare the dust-corrected [O III] 4364/5008 and [O III] 88/5008 line ratios measured from JWST/NIRSpec IFS and ALMA Band 8 against homogeneous PyNeb Te-ne model grids.
claims.result: COS-2987 has [O III] 4364/5008 = 0.038 (+0.010/-0.011) and [O III] 88/5008 = 0.22 (+0.09/-0.07), falling outside the homogeneous PyNeb model grids.
claims.finding: A simple homogeneous ionized gas model with a single set of electron temperature and density cannot reproduce the observed [O III] line ratios in COS-2987.

evidence.loc: 4. [O iii] LINE RATIO DIAGNOSTICS COMBINING JWST AND ALMA
evidence.quote: In the left panel of Figure 3, the observed ratios for COS-2987, COS-3018, and J0217-0218 lie outside the _T_ e – _n_ e model grids, whereas the other high- _z_ galaxies fall within the grid.

evidence.loc: 4. [O iii] LINE RATIO DIAGNOSTICS COMBINING JWST AND ALMA
evidence.quote: The results indicate that the [O iii] line ratios of COS2987 cannot be reproduced by a simple model of homogeneous ionized gas with uniform temperature and density.

claims.hypothesis: Inhomogeneously distributed dust within the ISM causes an underestimation of optical [O III] fluxes when using spatially integrated Balmer decrements, explaining the anomalous [O III] line ratios.
claims.experiment: Construct a spatially resolved A_V map from Voronoi-binned PSF-matched Halpha/Hbeta maps and apply a pixel-by-pixel dust extinction correction to the [O III] 4364 and 5008 intensity maps.
claims.result: The [O III] 4364/5008 and [O III] 88/5008 ratios change by factors of ~1.07 and ~0.82 respectively, still lying outside the homogeneous model regime corresponding to the [O II] density.
claims.finding: Inhomogeneously distributed dust is not the primary cause of the discrepancy in the [O III] line ratios of COS-2987.

evidence.quote: As a result, we find that the [O iii]4364/5008 and [O iii]88/5008 ratios change by factors of _∼_ 1 _._ 07 and _∼_ 0 _._ 82, respectively.
This supports the view that inhomogeneously distributed dust is not the primary cause of the observed discrepancy in the [O iii] line ratios of COS-2987.

claims.hypothesis: A density-stratified, two-component ionized ISM can simultaneously reproduce the observed optical and FIR [O III] line ratios in COS-2987.
claims.experiment: Model the [O III] 4364, 5008, and 88 um line luminosities using PyNeb with a compact, hot, dense component (Te = 26,000 K, ne = 500 cm^-3) and an extended, cooler, diffuse component (Te = 8,000 K, ne = 50 cm^-3) as a function of volume ratio.
claims.result: The observed [O III] 88/5008 and [O III] 4364/5008 ratios are simultaneously reproduced when the volume ratio is V1/V2 ~ 1/300 (mass ratio M1/M2 ~ 1/30).
claims.finding: COS-2987 hosts a density-stratified ionized ISM comprising compact, hot, dense H II regions surrounded by an extended, cooler, low-density ionized medium.

evidence.loc: 5.2. Evidence for a density-stratified ionized ISM
evidence.quote: We find that the observed [O iii] line ratios are well reproduced by a model consisting of component 1 with ( _T_ e _,_ 1 _, n_ e _,_ 1 ) = (26 _,_ 000 K _,_ 500 cm _[−]_ [3] ) and component 2 with ( _T_ e _,_ 2 _, n_ e _,_ 2 ) = (8 _,_ 000 K _,_ 50 cm _[−]_ [3] ).

evidence.loc: 5.2. Evidence for a density-stratified ionized ISM
evidence.quote: By comparing the model predictions with the observed values of [O iii]88/5008 and [O iii]4364/5008, we derive a volume ratio of _V_ 1 _/V_ 2 _∼_ 1 _/_ 300.

why_this_data.value: Combining JWST NIRSpec IFS and ALMA avoids the slit-loss and position-angle uncertainties of NIRSpec MOS and provides four [O III] transitions from the same ion with vastly different critical densities, enabling nebular diagnostics independent of abundance ratio assumptions.

evidence.quote: these studies utilized the NIRSpec multi-object spectroscopy (MOS) mode to observe optical [O iii] emission lines, which are subject to uncertainties arising from slit-loss corrections and from effects related to the position angle

why_this_method.value: A simplified two-component toy model focusing on three [O III] lines limits the number of free parameters compared to comprehensive models like MULTIGRIS, allowing identification of the key physical conditions.

evidence.quote: We stress again that the specific combination of _T_ e, _n_ e, and _V_ 1 _/V_ 2 parameters presented above is not a unique solution.

limitations_admitted.value: The [O II] 3727,3730 emission likely originates from a different, third ionization phase not included in the two-component [O III] model.

evidence.loc: 5.2. Evidence for a density-stratified ionized ISM
evidence.quote: We also note that the observed [O ii]3727,3730 emission likely originates from a different ionization phase not included in our current model.

limitations_admitted.value: Current ALMA spatial resolution (0.80'' x 0.61'') cannot spatially resolve the two ionized gas components or subtle morphological differences between [O III]5008 and [O III]88.

evidence.loc: B. RADIAL PROFILES OF [O iii]5008 AND [O iii]88
evidence.quote: The two emission lines exhibit consistent radial distributions within the uncertainties, indicating that there is no significant evidence of spatial separation between the two lines at the current ALMA resolution.

referee_caveats_inferred: The two-component toy model has more free parameters than observed line ratios (5 parameters: Te1, ne1, Te2, ne2, V1/V2 for 2 ratios), making the parameter values illustrative rather than uniquely constrained.
Pixel-by-pixel dust correction still averages over the ~0.21'' JWST PSF (~1.1 kpc at z=6.81), which cannot rule out sub-resolution clumpy dust mixed with individual star-forming cores.
